customManagers.description: ARG LIBRESPEED_VERSION and the ARG LIBRESPEED_COMMIT beneath it, captured together so one PR moves both. The dockerfile manager only reads an ARG that a FROM expands, and these feed the fetch stage's checkout. The release has no assets, so github-tags reads the tag, and its digest is the commit the tag names, which the fetch stage checks out and asserts the tag still names. Upstream tags releases as v6.3.1. The two ARGs must stay adjacent and in this order.

packageRules.description: The LibreSpeed release merges once every check passes, like every other update here, and majors are no exception: the acceptance suite, not the size of the bump, is what holds a release back.
